segments.comment: A debug gnomish Healer level-teleports to D:3, wishes for a cursed scroll of stinking cloud and a wand of death, creates a dwarf beside her, centres the cloud on the dwarf ('It coughs!  It gets angry!': the cloud is the hero's fault) and dies to the wand on the next turn, saving bones with the cloud still on the level.

A Samurai loads the bones on D:3 and forces ten searches. region.c rest_regions() reads a bones file with `ghostly` set and clears heros_fault, so when the dwarf dies in the cloud out of sight C calls monkilled() and prints nothing; a cloud that kept the dead hero's fault would call killed() and print 'You kill it!'.

comment: region.c rest_regions(), ghostly arm: a gas cloud loaded from bones no longer pertains to the dead hero. The seeds, clocks, characters and inputs were chosen for this case.
